name: coord_quantum_yds
rationale: assumed vendor coordinate precision (2 decimals); verify on raw x, y

name: kgram_frames
rationale: 1 s at 10 Hz — long enough that coincidental equality is implausible

name: kgram_min_motion_yds
rationale: excludes stationary windows whose displacements are all ~0

name: align_speed
rationale: MovementConfig.onset_speed_fast (robust to pre-start drift)

name: align_frames
rationale: MovementConfig.onset_frames

name: max_lag_s
rationale: onset anchors of two attempts can differ by a few frames

name: grid_dt_s
rationale: KinematicsConfig.nominal_interval_ms / 1000

name: min_overlap_frac
rationale: pairs with little common aligned time are 'not_comparable'

name: exact_shared_frac
rationale: identical timestamps AND coordinates on ≥ 95 % of frames

name: reuse_kgram_frac
rationale: half of the moving 1-s displacement windows shared

name: reuse_shared_frame_frac
rationale: a fifth of the frames identical in time and position

name: near_dup_pos_rmse_yds
rationale: below M1 tier-B residual-noise limit (TierRules.b_max_resid_rms = 0.06 yd): two real runs should not agree more closely than the measurement noise

name: near_dup_speed_rmse
rationale: ≈ 1 % of forty peak speed; far below between-attempt variation

name: consistent_speed_rmse
rationale: example selection only; never used to flag

name: cross_athlete_min_frames
rationale: short static recordings can coincide by chance

name: cross_athlete_min_path_yds
rationale: as above, for distance

name: zero_sd_abs
rationale: float32 storage noise floor

name: zero_sd_rel
rationale: relative float32 noise floor

name: quantized_unique_frac
rationale: grid-searched fit parameters (tau step 0.01 s, t0 step 0.02 s) tie by construction; explains zero SD, not flags it

name: max_attempts_per_group
rationale: bounds pairwise work; larger groups are flagged
